verified_sources.key_insights: Heavy-duty non-woven vinyl (الفينيل الكوري والألماني) vs paper-backed wallpaper. Adhesion failure mechanisms in high humidity / intermittent air conditioning. Scrubbability classes.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Residential Building Climate & HVAC Inspection Report
verified_sources.key_insights: The 'Summer Vacation Trap' (مصيدة إجازة الصيف): Homeowners traveling for 6-8 weeks and turning off AC results in indoor temperatures exceeding 42°C and humidity rising, causing standard wallpaper glues (starch/methyl cellulose) to liquefy, bubble, and mold behind panels.
Cost of Korean 16m² roll (106cm x 15.6m): 14 to 28 KWD raw; 22 to 38 KWD turnkey installed with anti-fungal adhesive. Comparison with paint cost per wall (15-35 KWD).
